title: Reflowing bandline + priority hinting + TTS window summaries for time-series charts
creator: Lena Park
description: Problem: Our time-series bandline (area + min/max ribbon used for uncertainty) and annotation overlays perform well for small traces but degrade in interaction latency on high-cardinality datasets. Additionally, screen-reader users currently only get a raw table export which is noisy; we need concise, human-friendly summaries that work with VoiceOver/TalkBack and external TTS. Goals: (1) maintain <80ms p95 interaction latency for pan/zoom on typical 1k-point traces, (2) introduce a compact, voice-friendly summary generator per visible time window (ttsSummary) exposed on the chart API, (3) define a 'priority hinting' model for annotations so the renderer can drop low-value marks first under load, and (4) provide a robust accessible fallback for canvas rendering (semantic snapshot + table + ARIA announcements).
tasks: Audit current bandline rendering: canvas path count, overlapping draw ops, and annotation layering order
Prototype a reflowing bandline mode that decimates on the main thread and computes layout in worker via OffscreenCanvas
Design an API: ttsSummary(windowStart, windowEnd, opts) -> structured sentence list (human-readable). Include options for verbosity and locale
Define annotation priority attributes (importance score, sticky, ephemeral) and mapping to visual affordances
Create screen-reader fallback: summarized table + downloadable CSV link exposed via ellipsis menu
Write accessibility spec for keyboard flows: focus order, summary trigger, and polite aria-live region behavior
Benchmarks: microbenchmarks for pan/zoom with 1k/5k/20k points (canvas vs hybrid SVG/Canvas)
Implement hit-target expansion for touch (min 44px) and pointer-event throttling for heavy traces
decisions: Adopt hybrid renderer: primary drawing on Canvas for performance; keep an offscreen semantic layer (lightweight DOM table) for SR fallback
Expose a ttsSummary API that returns an array of short sentences. TTS synthesis left to integrator; chart provides text. Default verbosity = 'concise'
Annotation priority: numeric 0..100. Default derived from annotation type (alert > note > measurement). Renderer will drop annotations with score < threshold during heavy load
Use polite aria-live announcements for non-critical updates (aggregation change, sampling applied). Critical alerts will use assertive only when user explicitly requests an alert summary
accessibility_notes: TTS summaries should be short, descriptive sentences: e.g., 'From 09:00 to 12:00, median latency rose from 120ms to 230ms with a 95th percentile spike to 560ms.' Provide locale-sensitive number/date formatting. When chart is focused, keyboard shortcut 'S' will announce the current visible summary (via aria-live polite). Provide a 'Download summary' action for screen reader users. For canvas-only clients, create a hidden DOM table with simplified rows (timestamp, metric, delta, annotation-summary) that SRs can traverse. Document reduced-motion and high-contrast considerations for bandline transitions and color ramps.
performance_notes: Primary strategy: decimation + progressive rendering. Decimation algorithm: amplitude-preserving reservoir sampling per pixel bin. Rendering pipeline: compute decimation off-main-thread, upload vertex paths to GPU-friendly canvas path buffers, then composite annotations. Use OffscreenCanvas with fallback to requestIdleCallback-based batching where Offscreen is unavailable. Cache generated ttsSummary per time window using LRU keyed by model of aggregation + time range. Target p95 pan/zoom latency < 80ms with 1k points and < 150ms for 5k on modern desktop; mobile targets are relaxed by 2x. Add a perf toggle in Console to force 'low-latency' or 'high-fidelity' rendering modes.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec and Figma prototypes reviewed and approved by PM and Accessibility lead
Engineering POC demonstrates OffscreenCanvas reflow mode and meets p95 < 150ms on 5k synthetic trace
ttsSummary API returns predictable, localized sentence arrays for three sample datasets and is documented in the component README
Screen-reader fallback exposes the summary control and table; VoiceOver reads summary when user triggers 'announce' and reads rollback-friendly sentences
Annotation priority mechanism present and validated by synthetic load test that drops low-priority marks under stress
Unit and integration tests for keyboard flows and aria-live messages present in the PR
